info.name: HubSpot Analytics Events Access Tokens File Validation API
Hubspot Validate a Source Code File

params.name: environment
params.description: The target environment for the operation (draft or published)

params.name: path
params.description: The file system path to the file or folder

items.docs:
Validates the source code file at the specified path for syntax errors, 
HubL compatibility, and other issues. Returns validation results without modifying the file.
